blocks.text: Air quality (hawa ka mayar) Air Quality Index (AQI) se napi jati hai. AQI kisi khaas jagah ki hawa mein maujood pollutants ki concentration ka paimana (measure) hai. Jab air quality achhi ho to hawa saaf hoti hai aur us mein thos zarre aur chemical pollutants bohat thore hote hain. Kharab air quality, jis mein pollutants zyada hon, aksar dhundli (hazy) hoti hai aur sehat aur environment ke liye khatarnak hoti hai.

50 se kam AQI achha (good) samjha jata hai; yani sehat ko khatre ke baghair bahar waqt guzarna mehfooz hai. 300 se zyada AQI hazardous (khatarnak) samjha jata hai. 18 saal se kam bachche, 65 saal se zyada umr ke log, aur dil aur phephron ki purani (chronic) bimariyon wale log zyada khatre (high risk) mein hote hain. Bahar kaam karne wale log lambe exposure ki wajah se aur bhi zyada khatre mein hote hain.

blocks.prompt: AQI 40 wale din aur AQI 320 wale din mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: AQI 40 (50 se kam) achha hai; bahar waqt guzarna mehfooz hai. AQI 320 (300 se zyada) hazardous hai; khaas kar bachche, buzurg, dil aur phephron ke mareez aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein hain aur unhen bahar jane se bachna chahiye.

items: AQI kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki concentration napta hai: 50 se kam achha, 300 se zyada hazardous.
Bachche, buzurg, dil aur phephron ke mareez aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein.
